text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
- Between 500,000 and 600,000 children in Zambia have been orphaned by AIDS, central bank governor Jacob Mwanza told a fund raising dinner dance for orphans at the weekend.
- Work at Zambia's first privately owned copper mine has commenced, with a total construction value of $26 million.

Police on Sunday raided the home of opposition leader Rodger Chongwe but failed to arrest him because he was not there. Chongwe faces treason charges for predicting a military coup if political tensions in Zambia are not eased.
